description: Permissions for the Settings, editor and capture overlay windows. App commands (app_version, open_url, start_capture, take_capture, copy_image, library_save, library_discard, library_update, library_open_latest, history_read, history_write, history_delete, history_purge_before, open_settings, save_png_as, get_hotkey, set_hotkey, get_print_screen_notice, settings_log, dismiss_print_screen_notice, open_keyboard_settings, overlay_frame, overlay_windows, overlay_ready, overlay_log, overlay_finish, get_magnifier, set_magnifier) are always allowed.
